digest_convention: Sort the 24 repository-relative POSIX paths lexicographically; hash the UTF-8 concatenation of each path, one NUL byte, the exact file bytes, and one NUL byte.

discovery_checkpoint.evidence_digest: A 46-file curated text bundle covers Cargo.toml, build.rs, license/patch docs, permissions, and required Rust sources including dialog additions. Build copies only that allowlist into dist/provider; init stages it under .pumarejo/provider and writes a project-relative Cargo path. Provider-aware manifest, legacy migration, doctor/drift, exact-file removal, foreign/link refusal, tarball-consumer proof, and docs fit the owned paths.

PROVIDER-AC-2.evidence: Init/remove integration coverage passed, including relative Cargo staging, atomic rollback, CRLF normalization, and exact restoration.

PROVIDER-AC-3.evidence: Doctor/init/remove focused coverage passed with linked, missing, duplicated, malformed, foreign, and changed owned projections failing closed.

PROVIDER-AC-4.evidence: Tarball package contract passed (3 files, 10 tests); provider and Cargo structural proofs passed (4 tests, 3 intentional platform skips) with no absolute Cargo path.

PROVIDER-AC-5.evidence: Focused provider suite passed (4 files, 100 tests), build passed, pack check passed, and package/release/platform checks passed.

EOLB-AC-1.evidence: Uniform Cargo sources carry one exact eol:cargo token and matching owned marker; mixed sources carry neither, verified by unit and integration coverage.

EOLB-AC-2.evidence: Swapped token, missing/changed/duplicated marker, and marker/token mismatch all produced owned-value-drift or ALREADY_INTEGRATED_MODIFIED in direct reproductions and focused tests.

EOLB-AC-3.evidence: External whole-file LF normalization restored original CRLF bytes; mixed-EOL sources remained byte-preserving and unnormalized.

EOLB-AC-4.evidence: Focused suite, build, and pack check all passed.

FPR-AC-1.evidence: Removed/forged uniform EOL attribution failed closed in doctor, repeated init, and remove; mixed compatibility remained intact.

FPR-AC-2.evidence: Created dependency validation requires exact optional/path/version keys, one generated marker, and one canonical inline declaration; foreign extra key and missing marker reproductions drifted and removal failed closed.

FPR-AC-3.evidence: Focused attribution/init/remove/doctor suite passed 100 tests; build and pack check passed.
